description: Prepare an unsigned perpetual order for one reviewed venue, without signing or submitting it. Venue decides the artifact shape: hyperliquid returns an unsigned exchange order envelope (HyperCore); synthetix-perps-v3-base returns EVM calldata for commitOrder whose acceptablePrice is derived from Insight cross-oracle consensus, not the Synthetix mark price; aster-perps-bnb-mainnet returns a canonical centralized REST order payload (not calldata, and it proves payload binding rather than on-chain execution); solana_drift returns a Borsh instruction payload that the caller must complete with the Drift SDK. The reviewed guard runs inside each adapter, so the result carries the risk verdict reference. Use it when an agent has decided on venue, market, side and size. Do not use it to create a nonce, sign, or submit an order. Returns the shared prepared-execution envelope: `state` (READY, CAUTION, REQUIRES_COMPLETION, BLOCK or UNAVAILABLE), a payload whose `kind` is `evm-transaction`, `venue-rest-order`, `solana-instruction` or null, a required `validity_anchor` (timestamp, EVM block, Solana block height or venue policy), caller requirements and the guard verdict reference. It never returns a uniformly described executable trade package, and a payload that still needs caller completion is never labelled READY. A `venue-rest-order` payload exposes `execution_binding` with `proves_onchain_execution: false` and the `signing` requirement. Solana message payloads carry `transactionHash` (sha256 of the exact unsigned bytes, byte binding only, not signature-verifiable) and `messageHash` (null when the message segment cannot be derived). Deprecated alias: prefer trade_guard with op "prepare_perp_order". Removed on 2027-01-06.
